scope.zh: 依据2023年目录和2025年调整编纂，收录132项现行条目（23项禁止类、109项限制类）及3项已删除历史条目。历史条目仅在查询旧编号时出现。2026年第48号公告另作登记要求提示，其拟议分类不作为已生效目录条目。未命中不能作为不受其他限制的依据。
scope.en: Consolidated from the 2023 catalog and 2025 amendment: 132 current entries (23 prohibited and 109 restricted), plus three removed historical entries shown only for old-code searches. Announcement No. 48 of 2026 is presented separately as a registration notice; its proposed classifications are not treated as effective catalog entries. No match does not rule out other restrictions.

translationNote.zh: 英文为非官方工作译文。中文原文是范围核对依据；翻译不改变控制条件。
translationNote.en: English text is an unofficial working translation. The Chinese source governs scope verification; translations do not alter the control conditions.

matchNotice.zh: 检索命中是技术条目候选，不是对产品或交易的最终法律结论。
matchNotice.en: A search match is a candidate technology entry, not a final legal determination about the product or transaction.

dateSemantics.zh: validFrom表示本条当前展示文本所依据版本的生效日，不表示该技术首次列管日；removedOn为删除生效日。
dateSemantics.en: validFrom is the effective date of the source version used for the displayed text, not necessarily the date the technology was first listed. removedOn is the effective removal date.

contentMethod.zh: 中文控制要点来自上传PDF，规范化了空格、换行、上下标和标点显示；保留数值、不等号、限定范围及条款编号。英文逐项翻译。摘要、关键词、核对提示和下一步为编者整理。
contentMethod.en: Chinese control points are transcribed from the uploaded PDFs with display normalization of spaces, line breaks, subscripts/superscripts and punctuation. Values, operators, scope qualifiers and point numbering are retained. English is translated point by point. Summaries, keywords, verification hints and next steps are editorial guidance.

externalReferenceScope.zh: 目录援引的其他名录、标准、种质资源范围及动态行政认定，须另行核查；本数据集保留引用，不将其全部展开为自动判断规则。
externalReferenceScope.en: Other lists, standards, germplasm scopes and evolving administrative determinations referenced by the catalog require separate review. This dataset preserves those references but does not expand all of them into automated decision rules.

title.zh: 中药材资源及生产技术
title.en: Traditional Chinese medicinal resources and production technology

blocks.zh: 1.世界珍稀、濒危保护动植物中的野生中药资源及其繁育技术
blocks.en: 1. Wild traditional Chinese medicinal resources among the world’s rare and endangered protected animals and plants, and their breeding technology.

blocks.zh: 2.濒危、珍稀药材代用品的配方和生产技术
blocks.en: 2. Formulations and production technology for substitutes for endangered and rare medicinal materials.

blocks.zh: 3.菌类药材的菌种、菌株、纯化、培养、发酵和生产工艺，包括下列菌种：冬虫夏草、羊肚菌、牛舌菌、云芝、树舌、灵芝（紫芝、赤芝）、雷丸、猪苓、密环菌、松茸、短裙竹荪、长裙竹荪、黄裙竹荪、大马勃、黑柄炭角菌、茯苓
blocks.en: 3. Species, strains, purification, cultivation, fermentation and production processes for medicinal fungi, including the following fungi: Dongchongxiacao (Chinese caterpillar fungus), Yangdujun (morel), Niushejun (beefsteak fungus), Yunzhi, Shushe, Lingzhi (Zizhi and Chizhi), Leiwan, Zhuling, Mihuanjun, Songrong (matsutake), Duanqun Zhusun, Changqun Zhusun, Huangqun Zhusun, Damabo, Heibing Tanjiaojun, and Fuling. Transliterated names preserve the specific medicinal-fungus designations used in the Chinese original.

summary.zh: 涵盖珍稀濒危药用动植物资源、代用品配方及列明药用真菌的菌种和生产工艺。
summary.en: Covers rare and endangered medicinal animal and plant resources, substitute formulations, and strains and production processes for the listed medicinal fungi.

keywords: 中药材资源及生产技术
Traditional Chinese medicinal resources and production technology

title.zh: 中药饮片炮制技术
title.en: Processing technology for prepared traditional Chinese medicinal materials

blocks.zh:
1.毒性中药的炮制工艺和产地加工技术
（1）制川乌（2）制草乌（3）制南星、胆南星（4）制白附子（5）清半夏、法半夏、姜半夏（6）制关白附（7）制附子（8）制商陆（9）制马钱子（10）煨肉豆蔻（11）制芫花（12）制蟾酥（13）制藤黄（14）制甘遂（15）制狼毒（16）巴豆霜（17）制斑蝥（18）制青娘子（19）飞雄黄（20）飞朱砂（21）制金大戟（22）千金子霜
blocks.en:
1. Processing procedures and processing-at-origin technology for toxic traditional Chinese medicines:
(1) Processed Chuanwu; (2) processed Caowu; (3) processed Nanxing and Dannanxing; (4) processed Baifuzi; (5) Qingbanxia, Fabanxia and Jiangbanxia; (6) processed Guanbaifu; (7) processed Fuzi; (8) processed Shanglu; (9) processed Maqianzi; (10) roasted Roudoukou; (11) processed Yuanhua; (12) processed Chansu; (13) processed Tenghuang; (14) processed Gansui; (15) processed Langdu; (16) Badoushuang; (17) processed Banmao; (18) processed Qingniangzi; (19) water-levigated realgar; (20) water-levigated cinnabar; (21) processed Jindaji; (22) Qianjinzishuang. The transliterated names identify the specific medicinal materials and preparations in the Chinese original.

blocks.zh:
2.常用大宗中药的炮制工艺和产地加工技术
（1）熟大黄（2）熟地黄（3）制何首乌（4）制香附（5）鹿茸（6）紫河车（7）六神曲
（8）建神曲（9）炮山甲（10）制肉苁蓉（11）制黄精（12）制山茱萸（13）制女贞子（14）红参（15）厚朴（16）阿胶（17）龙血竭
blocks.en:
2. Processing procedures and processing-at-origin technology for commonly used bulk traditional Chinese medicines:
(1) Shudahuang; (2) Shudihuang; (3) processed Heshouwu; (4) processed Xiangfu; (5) Lurong; (6) Ziheche; (7) Liushenqu; (8) Jianshenqu; (9) Pao Shanjia; (10) processed Roucongrong; (11) processed Huangjing; (12) processed Shanzhuyu; (13) processed Nüzhenzi; (14) Hongshen; (15) Houpo; (16) Ejiao; (17) Longxuejie. The transliterated names identify the specific medicinal materials and preparations in the Chinese original.

summary.zh: 涵盖列明的毒性中药及常用大宗中药炮制、产地加工技术，须按具体药材及炮制品核对。
summary.en: Covers processing and processing-at-origin technology for the listed toxic and commonly used bulk traditional Chinese medicines. Check the particular medicinal material and preparation.

keywords: Processing technology for prepared traditional Chinese medicinal materials

title.zh: 低维无机非金属材料生产技术
title.en: Production technology for low-dimensional inorganic nonmetallic materials

blocks.zh: 具有下列特征之一的硬质低密度、粘结着碳纤维或非纤维状碳的绝热材料生产技术
blocks.en: Production technology for rigid, low-density thermal-insulation materials bonded with carbon fibers or nonfibrous carbon and having any one of the following characteristics:

blocks.zh: 1.可在2273K（2000℃）以上高温条件下使用
blocks.en: 1. Capable of use at temperatures of 2273 K (2000°C) or above.

blocks.zh: 2.密度在100～300kg／m³之间
blocks.en: 2. Density between 100 and 300 kg/m³.

blocks.zh: 3.压缩强度在0.1～1.0MPa之间
blocks.en: 3. Compressive strength between 0.1 and 1.0 MPa.

blocks.zh: 4.挠曲强度≥1.0MPa
blocks.en: 4. Flexural strength ≥ 1.0 MPa.

blocks.zh: 5.碳含量占总固体的99.9%以上
blocks.en: 5. Carbon content accounting for at least 99.9% of total solids.

summary.zh: 针对特定含碳绝热材料，五项特征为择一条件，须先确认材料范围。
summary.en: Applies to specified carbon-containing insulation materials. The five characteristics are alternatives; first verify the defined material scope.

title.zh: 集成电路制造技术
title.en: Integrated-circuit manufacturing technology

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of computers, communications equipment and other electronic equipment

blocks.zh:
抗辐照技术、工艺
（1）抗静电≥2,500V，抗瞬时剂量率＞1×10¹¹rad（Si）/s的CMOS／SOS（蓝宝石上外延硅／互补型金属氧化物半导体）器件制造技术
（2）抗静电≥3,000V，抗瞬时剂量率＞1×10¹¹rad（Si）/s的双极器件制造技术
blocks.en:
Radiation-hardening technology and processes
(1) Manufacturing technology for CMOS/SOS (complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor / silicon-on-sapphire) devices with electrostatic-discharge resistance ≥ 2,500 V and transient dose-rate resistance > 1 × 10¹¹ rad(Si)/s.
(2) Manufacturing technology for bipolar devices with electrostatic-discharge resistance ≥ 3,000 V and transient dose-rate resistance > 1 × 10¹¹ rad(Si)/s.

summary.zh: 涉及同时达到指定抗静电与抗瞬时辐射剂量率指标的CMOS/SOS及双极器件制造技术。
summary.en: Covers CMOS/SOS and bipolar-device manufacturing technology meeting the specified electrostatic-discharge and transient radiation dose-rate resistance criteria.

title.zh: 经济作物栽培繁育技术
title.en: Cash-crop cultivation and breeding technology

blocks.zh:
1.烟草重要核心种质资源及育种素材创制、基因分析鉴定技术
（1）经鉴定属于重要抗源的种质资源，包括免疫或高抗病毒病、黑胫病、青枯病、赤星病、白粉病、烟蚜、烟青虫、根结线虫等主要病虫害的烟草种质资源
（2）特异性烟草种质资源，包括多叶型、特香型、特殊香型、高钾、高糖、高蛋白、白花等形态或生理遗传标记、优质、地方名优晾晒烟的主栽品种
（3）烟碱含量在6%以上的高烟碱种质资源
（4）属国际先进的雄性不育二系配套育种材料、种质资源，特殊育种用途的种质资源
（5）在我国收集发现的珍贵和稀有地方种质资源
blocks.en:
1. Important core tobacco germplasm resources, creation of breeding materials, and gene analysis and identification technology
(1) Germplasm identified as important sources of resistance, including tobacco germplasm immune or highly resistant to major diseases and pests such as viral diseases, black shank, bacterial wilt, brown spot, powdery mildew, tobacco aphids, tobacco budworms and root-knot nematodes.
(2) Specialized tobacco germplasm, including morphological or physiological genetic markers such as many-leaved types, exceptionally aromatic types, distinctive-aroma types, high potassium, high sugar, high protein and white flowers; high-quality varieties; and principal cultivated varieties of locally renowned air-cured and sun-cured tobacco.
(3) High-nicotine germplasm with nicotine content of 6% or more.
(4) Internationally advanced male-sterile two-line complementary breeding materials and germplasm, and germplasm for special breeding purposes.
(5) Valuable and rare local germplasm collected or discovered in China.

blocks.zh: 2.烟草介质花粉技术
blocks.en: 2. Tobacco medium-pollen technology (the source wording is “烟草介质花粉技术”).

summary.zh: 涉及特定烟草抗病虫种质、特殊性状、高烟碱及育种资源等；须核对具体种质与技术范围。
summary.en: Covers specified tobacco germplasm with disease or pest resistance, distinctive traits or high nicotine content, and breeding resources. Verify the specific germplasm and technical scope.

title.zh: 水产种质繁育技术
title.en: Aquatic germplasm breeding technology

blocks.zh: 1.《我国现阶段有条件对外交换的水产种质资源名录》所列种质的繁育技术
blocks.en: 1. Breeding technology for germplasm listed in the Catalogue of Aquatic Germplasm Resources Currently Eligible for Conditional Exchange with Foreign Countries.

blocks.zh:
2.淡水微藻的培养生产工艺
（1）藻种纯化和杂藻抑控制技术
（2）藻类培养工艺和浓缩技术
（3）有关监测工艺
（4）培养水体水质测控技术
blocks.en:
2. Cultivation and production processes for freshwater microalgae:
(1) Algal strain purification and suppression and control of contaminating algae.
(2) Algal cultivation processes and concentration technology.
(3) Relevant monitoring processes.
(4) Measurement and control of water quality in cultivation waters.

blocks.zh:
3.梭鱼人工繁殖技术
（1）淡水培育亲鱼，药物诱导人工繁殖育苗技术
blocks.en:
3. Artificial propagation of mullet:
(1) Broodstock rearing in freshwater and drug-induced artificial propagation and seedling production.

blocks.zh:
4.鳜鱼人工育苗及人工饲料养殖技术
（1）鳜鱼人工催产、育苗技术
（2）稚鱼开口饵料及其同步培养技术
blocks.en:
4. Artificial seedling production and formulated-feed culture of mandarin fish:
(1) Induced spawning and seedling production.
(2) First-feeding diets for larval fish and their synchronized cultivation.

blocks.zh:
5.河蟹人工繁殖技术
（1）催产技术、设施、工艺
（2）幼体培育、开口饵料
（3）病害防治
（4）河蟹亲体培育
blocks.en:
5. Artificial propagation of river crabs:
(1) Induced spawning technology, facilities and processes.
(2) Larval rearing and first-feeding diets.
(3) Disease prevention and control.
(4) Broodstock rearing.

blocks.zh:
6.石斑鱼人工育苗技术
（1）亲鱼培育
（2）催熟、催产技术、药物
（3）苗种培育，食性转换，过渡饵料
blocks.en:
6. Artificial seedling production of groupers:
(1) Broodstock rearing.
(2) Technology and drugs for induced maturation and spawning.
(3) Seedling rearing, feeding-habit transition and transitional diets.

blocks.zh:
7.乌塘鳢人工育苗技术
（1）幼鱼培育技术、工艺
（2）亲鱼培育、催产技术、工艺
blocks.en:
7. Artificial seedling production of Chinese sleeper (Bostrychus sinensis):
(1) Juvenile rearing technology and processes.
(2) Broodstock rearing and induced spawning technology and processes.

blocks.zh: 8.合浦绒螯蟹人工繁殖技术
blocks.en: 8. Artificial propagation of the Hepu mitten crab.

summary.zh: 涵盖特定水产种质、淡水微藻及鱼蟹繁育技术，须核对具体种质和控制点。
summary.en: Covers specified aquatic germplasm, freshwater microalgae, and fish and crab breeding technology. Verify the particular germplasm and control point.

title.zh: 工艺品制造技术
title.en: Handicraft manufacturing technology

industry.zh: 文教、工美、体育和娱乐用品制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of cultural, educational, arts and crafts, sports and recreational products

blocks.zh:
1.金属工艺品生产技术及工艺
（1）斑铜表面处理工艺
blocks.en:
1. Production technology and processes for metal handicrafts
(1) Surface-treatment processes for mottled copper.

blocks.zh:
2.漆器工艺品制造技术及工艺
（1）点螺漆器的原料加工及制作工艺
blocks.en:
2. Manufacturing technology and processes for lacquerware handicrafts
(1) Raw-material processing and production processes for fine mother-of-pearl inlay lacquerware (“点螺漆器”).

blocks.zh:
3.刺绣品的制作技术及工艺
（1）双面三异绣、三异缂丝工艺及摘小针处理方法
（2）明代四团龙织金纱龙袍、花缎龙袍、孔雀羽织金妆花的技术诀窍
blocks.en:
3. Production technology and processes for embroidered articles
(1) Processes for double-sided “three-difference” embroidery and “three-difference” kesi silk tapestry, and the “摘小针” fine-stitch treatment method.
(2) Technical know-how for Ming-dynasty dragon robes of gold-woven gauze with four dragon roundels, dragon robes of patterned satin, and gold-woven figured fabrics incorporating peacock feathers.

blocks.zh:
4.其它工艺品的制作技术及工艺
（1）鼻烟壶等工艺品的内画技艺
blocks.en:
4. Production technology and processes for other handicrafts
(1) Inside-painting techniques for snuff bottles and other handicrafts.

summary.zh: 涉及斑铜、点螺漆器、特定刺绣与缂丝、龙袍织造及鼻烟壶内画等工艺。
summary.en: Covers mottled copper, fine mother-of-pearl lacquerware, specified embroidery and kesi weaving, dragon-robe weaving and inside-painted snuff bottles.

blocks.zh: 1.蛹虫草人工培植技术
blocks.en: 1. Artificial cultivation technology for Cordyceps militaris.

blocks.zh: 2.人工养麝（林麝、马麝）活体取香技术及繁育技术
blocks.en: 2. Technology for extracting musk from live, artificially reared musk deer (forest musk deer and alpine musk deer), and their breeding technology.

blocks.zh: 3.牛体培植牛黄的埋核技术
blocks.en: 3. Nucleus-implantation technology for cultivating bovine bezoars in cattle.

blocks.zh: 4.人工牛黄、人工虎骨、人工麝香等品种配方技术
blocks.en: 4. Formulation technology for artificial bovine bezoar, artificial tiger bone, artificial musk and other such preparations.

blocks.zh: 5.《中华人民共和国药典》中收录的大宗品种药材的植物种子（包括种子类生药）、种苗和动物种源及其繁育技术
blocks.en: 5. Plant seeds (including seeds used as crude drugs), seedlings, animal breeding stock and their breeding technology for bulk medicinal materials included in the Pharmacopoeia of the People’s Republic of China.

blocks.zh: 6.《国家重点保护野生植物名录》《国家重点保护野生动物名录》中收录的我国药材种质和基因资源及其人工繁育技术
blocks.en: 6. Chinese medicinal germplasm and genetic resources included in the List of Wild Plants under State Priority Protection or the List of Wild Animals under State Priority Protection, and their artificial breeding technology.

summary.zh: 涉及特定药用资源人工繁育、活体取香、牛黄培植、人工代用品配方及列明种质资源。
summary.en: Covers specified medicinal-resource breeding, live-animal musk extraction, bovine-bezoar cultivation, synthetic-substitute formulations and listed germplasm resources.

blocks.zh:

（1）流行性出血热灭活疫苗生产毒种（含野鼠型及家鼠型）
（2）EV71疫苗病毒
blocks.en:
1. Bacterial or viral strains obtained through isolation and screening that are suitable for industrial production, and technology for their selection and breeding
(1) Viral strains for producing inactivated epidemic hemorrhagic fever vaccines, including field-mouse and house-rat types.
(2) Virus for EV71 vaccines.

blocks.zh:

（1）甲型肝炎减毒活疫苗生产毒种
（2）乙型脑炎减毒活疫苗生产毒种
（3）水痘减毒活疫苗生产毒种
blocks.en:
2. Attenuated bacterial or viral strains used in live-vaccine production, and technology for their selection and breeding
(1) Viral strains for producing live attenuated hepatitis A vaccines.
(2) Viral strains for producing live attenuated Japanese encephalitis vaccines.
(3) Viral strains for producing live attenuated varicella vaccines.

blocks.zh: 3.野生或用基因工程方法获得的具有生物危害的菌种、毒种及其选育技术
blocks.en: 3. Wild-type or genetically engineered bacterial or viral strains posing biological hazards, and technology for their selection and breeding.

blocks.zh: 4.口服轮状病毒生产毒种
blocks.en: 4. Viral strains for oral rotavirus production.

summary.zh: 涉及指定疫苗生产菌毒种、减毒菌毒种及具有生物危害的菌毒种和相关选育技术。

title.zh: 无机非金属材料生产技术
title.en: Production technology for inorganic nonmetallic materials

blocks.zh:
1.非金属纤维无石棉增强抗磨材料制备技术
（1）非金属纤维无石棉增强材料的配方和加工工艺
（2）抗磨剂生产技术
blocks.en:
1. Preparation technology for asbestos-free, nonmetallic-fiber-reinforced wear-resistant materials:
(1) Formulations and processing procedures for asbestos-free, nonmetallic-fiber-reinforced materials.
(2) Production technology for antiwear agents.

blocks.zh:
2.连续SiC（碳化硅）纤维生产技术
（1）聚碳硅烷分子量及分子量分布控制技术
（2）有机硅聚合物连续纺丝技术
（3）二步不熔化处理技术
（4）聚碳硅烷裂解合成工艺
blocks.en:
2. Production technology for continuous SiC (silicon carbide) fibers:
(1) Control of polycarbosilane molecular weight and molecular-weight distribution.
(2) Continuous spinning of organosilicon polymers.
(3) Two-stage infusibilization treatment.
(4) Polycarbosilane pyrolytic synthesis processes.

blocks.zh:
3.具有下列特征的碳纤维制品加工技术
（1）细编穿刺织物技术
（2）三向锥体织物技术
blocks.en:
3. Processing technology for carbon-fiber products having the following characteristics:
(1) Fine-braided pierced-fabric technology.
(2) Three-directional conical-fabric technology.

blocks.zh: 4.氮化硼（BN）纤维防潮涂层制备技术
blocks.en: 4. Preparation technology for moisture-resistant coatings on boron nitride (BN) fibers.

blocks.zh: 5.氧化锆纤维隔热材料制备技术
blocks.en: 5. Preparation technology for zirconia-fiber thermal-insulation materials.

blocks.zh: 6.化学气相沉积法（CVD）制备碳化硅（SiC）纤维技术
blocks.en: 6. Technology for preparing silicon carbide (SiC) fibers by chemical vapor deposition (CVD).

summary.zh: 涉及无石棉增强抗磨材料、连续碳化硅纤维、特定碳纤维织物及其他纤维制备技术。
summary.en: Includes asbestos-free reinforced wear-resistant materials, continuous silicon carbide fibers, specified carbon-fiber fabrics and other fiber-preparation technologies.

keywords: 无机非金属材料生产技术
Production technology for inorganic nonmetallic materials

title.zh: 人工晶体生长与加工技术
title.en: Artificial crystal growth and processing technology

blocks.zh: 1.二氧化碲（TeO₂）及钼酸铝〔Al₂(MoO₄)₃〕单晶生长工艺及基片的精加工技术
blocks.en: 1. Single-crystal growth processes for tellurium dioxide (TeO₂) and aluminum molybdate [Al₂(MoO₄)₃], and precision finishing technology for their substrates.

blocks.zh:
2.超长（＞250mm）铌酸锂晶片的制作方法
（1）长度＞280mm，直径＞40mm铌酸锂晶的生长技术
（2）长度＞250mm，铌酸锂单晶片精加工技术
blocks.en:
2. Methods for producing extra-long (> 250 mm) lithium niobate wafers:
(1) Growth technology for lithium niobate crystals with length > 280 mm and diameter > 40 mm.
(2) Precision finishing technology for lithium niobate single-crystal wafers with length > 250 mm.

blocks.zh:
3.长度＞180mm的硅酸铋（BSO）、锗酸铋（BGO）单晶生长工艺及晶片加工技术
4.75-3水溶性光致抗蚀掩孔干膜制备工艺
blocks.en:
3. Growth processes and wafer processing technology for bismuth silicate (BSO) and bismuth germanate (BGO) single crystals with length > 180 mm.
4. Preparation process for 75-3 water-soluble photoresist hole-masking dry film.

blocks.zh: 5.制造自泵浦相位共轭器（SPPCM）用钨青铜光析变单晶生长工艺
blocks.en: 5. Growth process for tungsten-bronze photorefractive single crystals (the source uses “光析变”) for self-pumped phase conjugate mirrors (SPPCM).

blocks.zh: 6.铌酸钾（KNbO₃）晶体的原料处理技术和生长工艺
blocks.en: 6. Raw-material treatment technology and growth processes for potassium niobate (KNbO₃) crystals.

blocks.zh: 7.磷酸氧钛钾（KTP）晶体生长控制技术
blocks.en: 7. Growth control technology for potassium titanyl phosphate (KTP) crystals.

blocks.zh:
8.具有下列性能的抗辐射人造水晶生长工艺
（1）品质因数（Q）值≥3×10⁶
（2）包裹体级别不低于IECI（国际电工技术委员会）的A级
（3）铝（Al）含量≤1ppm
（4）腐蚀隧道密度≤10条/cm²
blocks.en:
8. Growth process for radiation-resistant synthetic quartz with the following properties:
(1) Quality factor (Q) ≥ 3 × 10⁶.
(2) Inclusion grade no lower than Grade A of the International Electrotechnical Commission (the source abbreviates this as “IECI”).
(3) Aluminum (Al) content ≤ 1 ppm.
(4) Etch-channel density ≤ 10 channels/cm².

blocks.zh:
9.稀土－铁（Tb-Dy-Fe系）超磁致伸缩单晶材料的制备技术
（1）提拉法无污染磁悬浮冷坩埚晶体生长工艺
（2）单晶成份及结构控制技术
blocks.en:
9. Preparation technology for rare-earth–iron (Tb-Dy-Fe system) giant-magnetostrictive single-crystal materials:
(1) Contamination-free crystal growth by the pulling method using a magnetically levitated cold crucible.
(2) Control technology for single-crystal composition and structure.

blocks.zh: 10.四硼酸锂、三硼酸锂（LBO）晶体的生长工艺
blocks.en: 10. Growth processes for lithium tetraborate and lithium triborate (LBO) crystals.

blocks.zh: 11.掺钕硼酸铝钇（NYAB）晶体的生长工艺
blocks.en: 11. Growth process for neodymium-doped yttrium aluminum borate (NYAB) crystals.

blocks.zh: 12.钛酸钡锶（SBT）晶体的生长工艺
blocks.en: 12. Growth process for strontium barium titanate crystals (SBT, as designated in the source).

blocks.zh: 13.偏硼酸钡（BBO）晶体的生长工艺
blocks.en: 13. Growth process for barium metaborate (BBO) crystals.

blocks.zh: 14.硼铍酸锶（SBBO）晶体的生长工艺
blocks.en: 14. Growth process for strontium beryllium borate (SBBO) crystals.

blocks.zh: 15.KBBF晶体生长与棱镜耦合器件加工技术
blocks.en: 15. KBBF crystal growth and prism-coupled device processing technology.

blocks.zh: 16.硅酸钇镥（LYSO）晶体生长工艺
blocks.en: 16. Growth process for lutetium yttrium silicate (LYSO) crystals.

blocks.zh: 17.溴化镧（LaBr₃:Ce）晶体生长工艺
blocks.en: 17. Growth process for lanthanum bromide (LaBr₃:Ce) crystals.

summary.zh: 涉及特定光学晶体、压电晶体和其他人工晶体的生长、精加工及相关材料技术，须逐项核对晶体种类与性能。
summary.en: Covers specified optical, piezoelectric, and other artificial crystal growth, precision processing, and related materials; verify each crystal type and performance criterion.

keywords: 人工晶体生长与加工技术
Artificial crystal growth and processing technology

title.zh: 聚合物基复合材料生产技术
title.en: Polymer-matrix composite production technology

blocks.zh: 1.用于航天器壳体的纤维增强树脂基复合材料生产技术
blocks.en: 1. Production technology for fiber-reinforced resin-matrix composites used in spacecraft shells.

blocks.zh: 2.用于高压容器（压力≥25MPa）的纤维增强树脂基耐烧蚀、隔热、防热、复合材料生产技术
blocks.en: 2. Production technology for fiber-reinforced resin-matrix composites providing ablation resistance, thermal insulation, and thermal protection for high-pressure vessels (pressure ≥ 25 MPa).

blocks.zh: 3.容重1.5～1.7g／cm²，烧蚀率≤0.22mm／s的纤维增强树脂基耐烧蚀复合材料生产技术

blocks.zh: 4.热熔法工艺中树脂基体配方
blocks.en: 4. Resin-matrix formulations used in hot-melt processing.

summary.zh: 涉及航天器壳体、高压容器及规定耐烧蚀性能的树脂基复合材料和热熔法树脂配方。
summary.en: Covers resin-matrix composites for spacecraft shells, high-pressure vessels, specified ablation-resistant applications, and resin formulations used in hot-melt processing.

title.zh: 有色金属冶金技术
title.en: Non-ferrous metallurgy technology

industry.zh: 有色金属冶炼和压延加工业
industry.en: Smelting and rolling of non-ferrous metals

blocks.zh: 1.无毒（不含氰化物）堆浸提金技术及配方
blocks.en: 1. Non-toxic (cyanide-free) heap-leaching technology and formulations for gold extraction.

blocks.zh: 2.通过离子交换法、树脂法等方法从氧化铝母液中提取金属镓的技术和工艺
blocks.en: 2. Technology and processes for extracting gallium metal from alumina mother liquor by ion exchange, resin-based methods and other methods.

blocks.zh: 3.强度≥520MPa铍材制备的制粉和固结工艺
blocks.en: 3. Powder production and consolidation processes for preparing beryllium materials with strength ≥ 520 MPa.

blocks.zh:
4.同时具有下列特性的高温超导线、带制造技术
（1）临界温度＞77K，长度＞100m，临界电流密度＞1×10⁴ A/cm²（在77K，自场强下）
blocks.en:
4. Manufacturing technology for high-temperature superconducting wires and tapes with all the following characteristics:
(1) Critical temperature > 77 K; length > 100 m; and critical current density > 1 × 10⁴ A/cm² at 77 K in self-field.

blocks.zh:
5.同时具有下列特性的高温超导薄膜制造技术
（1）临界温度＞77K，面积＞5cm²，临界电流密度＞1×10⁶ A/cm²（在77K，零场强下）
blocks.en:
5. Manufacturing technology for high-temperature superconducting thin films with all the following characteristics:
(1) Critical temperature > 77 K; area > 5 cm²; and critical current density > 1 × 10⁶ A/cm² at 77 K in zero field.

blocks.zh: 6.稀土的采矿、选矿、冶炼技术（已列入禁止出口的技术除外）
blocks.en: 6. Rare-earth mining, beneficiation and smelting technology, excluding technology already listed as prohibited for export.

blocks.zh: 7.稀土萃取剂的合成工艺及配方
blocks.en: 7. Synthesis processes and formulations for rare-earth extractants.

blocks.zh: 8.金属材料的稀土改性添加技术
blocks.en: 8. Technology for modifying metallic materials through rare-earth additions.

blocks.zh:
9.锂辉石提锂生产碳酸锂技术
（1）基于含锂净化液制备碳酸锂技术
（2）碳化热解提纯技术
（3）母液循环使用技术
（4）连续生产自动控制技术
（5）氢氧化锂碳化技术
blocks.en:
9. Technology for producing lithium carbonate by extracting lithium from spodumene:
(1) Preparing lithium carbonate from purified lithium-containing solutions.
(2) Purification by carbonation and thermal decomposition.
(3) Recycling mother liquor.
(4) Automatic control of continuous production.
(5) Carbonation of lithium hydroxide.

blocks.zh:
10.锂辉石提锂生产氢氧化锂技术
（1）基于含锂净化液制备氢氧化锂技术
（2）冷冻析钠技术
（3）蒸发结晶技术
（4）连续生产自动控制技术
（5）粉碎干燥技术
blocks.en:
10. Technology for producing lithium hydroxide by extracting lithium from spodumene:
(1) Preparing lithium hydroxide from purified lithium-containing solutions.
(2) Sodium precipitation by cooling.
(3) Evaporative crystallization.
(4) Automatic control of continuous production.
(5) Pulverizing and drying.

blocks.zh:
11.金属锂（合金）及锂材制备技术
（1）多阳极电解技术
（2）金属锂蒸馏提纯技术
（3）金属锂（合金）及锂材压延加工技术
blocks.en:
11. Preparation technology for lithium metal, lithium alloys and lithium materials:
(1) Multi-anode electrolysis.
(2) Distillation purification of lithium metal.
(3) Rolling processes for lithium metal, lithium alloys and lithium materials.

blocks.zh:
12.卤水提锂技术
（1）吸附剂材料合成技术（铝系、钛系、锰系）
（2）卤水吸附-膜分离提锂工艺集成技术
blocks.en:
12. Lithium extraction technology for brines:
(1) Synthesis of adsorbent materials based on aluminum, titanium or manganese.
(2) Integrated adsorption and membrane-separation processes for extracting lithium from brines.

blocks.zh:
13.含锂净化液制备技术
（1）离子交换除杂技术
（2）含锂溶液除B、Ca、K、Na、S等技术
（3）膜分离、电渗析除杂技术
blocks.en:
13. Technology for preparing purified lithium-containing solutions:
(1) Impurity removal by ion exchange.
(2) Removing B, Ca, K, Na, S and other substances from lithium-containing solutions.
(3) Impurity removal by membrane separation and electrodialysis.

summary.zh: 包括特定提金、提镓、铍材、高温超导、稀土及提锂技术。已合并2025年修改：替换第2项，保留第1、3—8项，新增第9—13项。
summary.en: Includes specified gold extraction, gallium extraction, beryllium, high-temperature superconducting, rare-earth and lithium technologies. The 2025 amendment replaces point 2, retains points 1 and 3–8, and adds points 9–13.

title.zh: 非晶、微晶金属冶金技术
title.en: Metallurgical technology for amorphous and microcrystalline metals

industry.zh: 有色金属冶炼和压延加工业
industry.en: Smelting and rolling of nonferrous metals

blocks.zh: 1.非晶材料的卷取技术
blocks.en: 1. Coiling technology for amorphous materials.

blocks.zh:
2.自蔓延高温合成与制备技术
（1）硬质耐冲击材料制备技术
（2）纳米级晶粒制备技术
blocks.en:
2. Self-propagating high-temperature synthesis and preparation technology:
(1) Preparation technology for hard, impact-resistant materials.
(2) Preparation technology for nanoscale grains.

blocks.zh: 3.纳米级超细粉的制备技术
blocks.en: 3. Preparation technology for nanoscale ultrafine powders.

summary.zh: 涵盖非晶材料卷取、自蔓延高温合成和纳米晶粒、超细粉制备。
summary.en: Covers amorphous-material coiling, self-propagating high-temperature synthesis, and preparation of nanoscale grains and ultrafine powders.

keywords: 非晶、微晶金属冶金技术
Metallurgical technology for amorphous and microcrystalline metals

title.en: Heat-treatment technology

blocks.zh:
1.模具热处理技术
（1）稀土－硼共渗剂配方
（2）稀土－硼共渗处理工艺
blocks.en:
1. Die and mold heat-treatment technology:
(1) Formulations of rare-earth/boron co-diffusion agents.
(2) Rare-earth/boron co-diffusion treatment processes.

blocks.zh: 2.稀土、碳、氮共渗和稀土、碳共渗的配方及工艺
blocks.en: 2. Formulations and processes for rare-earth/carbon/nitrogen co-diffusion and rare-earth/carbon co-diffusion.

blocks.zh: 3.装载机斗齿材料的配方及热处理工艺
blocks.en: 3. Loader bucket-tooth material formulations and heat-treatment processes.

summary.zh: 涉及稀土硼共渗、稀土碳氮共渗、稀土碳共渗及装载机斗齿材料配方和热处理。

title.zh: 金属基复合材料生产技术
title.en: Metal-matrix composite production technology

blocks.zh:
1.金属－陶瓷纳米级材料制备技术
（1）WC-Co（碳化钨－钴）亚微米级粉末制备技术
（2）WC-Co（碳化钨－钴）亚微米晶粒复合材料制备技术
blocks.en:
1. Preparation technology for nanoscale metal-ceramic materials:
(1) Preparation technology for submicron WC-Co (tungsten carbide–cobalt) powders.
(2) Preparation technology for WC-Co (tungsten carbide–cobalt) composites with submicron grains.

blocks.zh: 2.纤维增强铝基复合材料的制备技术
blocks.en: 2. Preparation technology for fiber-reinforced aluminum-matrix composites.

blocks.zh:
3.超混杂铝基复合板的制备技术
（1）竹材改性工艺
（2）改性竹材增强铝复合工艺
（3）维尼纶增强铝复合工艺
blocks.en:
3. Preparation technology for superhybrid aluminum-matrix composite panels:
(1) Bamboo modification processes.
(2) Processes for producing modified-bamboo-reinforced aluminum composites.
(3) Processes for producing vinylon-reinforced aluminum composites.

blocks.zh: 4.化学气相渗制备复合材料技术
blocks.en: 4. Composite preparation technology using chemical vapor infiltration.

summary.zh: 涉及特定金属陶瓷、纤维增强铝基、超混杂铝基复合板及化学气相渗复合材料制备。
summary.en: Covers specified metal-ceramic materials, fiber-reinforced aluminum composites, superhybrid aluminum composite panels, and chemical vapor infiltration composites.

keywords: 金属基复合材料生产技术

title.zh: 铸造技术
title.en: Casting technology

blocks.zh: 1.耐高温覆膜砂添加剂的配方
blocks.en: 1. Additive formulations for high-temperature-resistant resin-coated sand.

blocks.zh:
2.下列大中型薄壁变曲面铸件电渣熔铸技术
（1）非稳定状态下各种温度场的确定

blocks.en:

summary.en: Covers additive formulations for heat-resistant resin-coated sand and specified electroslag casting technology for thin-walled variable-curvature components.

blocks.zh:

（1）波纹成型工艺
（2）转筒旋压工艺及表面处理工艺
（3）转子装配、调试工艺
blocks.en:
1. Forming technology for metal centrifuge rotors:
(1) Corrugation forming processes.
(2) Rotor-drum spinning and surface-treatment processes.
(3) Rotor assembly and adjustment processes.

title.zh: 船型设计与试验技术
title.en: Ship-form design and testing technology

industry.zh: 铁路、船舶、航空航天和其他运输设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of railway, ship, aerospace, and other transportation equipment

blocks.zh: 1.水下机器人浮体材料和密封材料的配方与结构
blocks.en: 1. Formulations and structures of buoyancy materials and sealing materials for underwater robots.

blocks.zh:
2.浅吃水及超浅吃水肥大型船技术
（1）浅吃水肥大型：型宽与吃水深度比（B/T）≥3.5;方型系数（Cb）≥0.82
（2）超浅吃水肥大型：型宽与吃水深度比（B/T）≥4.0；方型系数（Cb）≥0.82
blocks.en:
2. Technology for shallow-draft and ultra-shallow-draft full-form vessels:
(1) Shallow-draft full-form type: molded breadth-to-draft ratio (B/T) ≥ 3.5; block coefficient (Cb) ≥ 0.82.
(2) Ultra-shallow-draft full-form type: molded breadth-to-draft ratio (B/T) ≥ 4.0; block coefficient (Cb) ≥ 0.82.

blocks.zh: 3.气垫船的围裙技术
blocks.en: 3. Skirt technology for hovercraft.

blocks.zh: 4.冲翼艇船型设计与试验技术
blocks.en: 4. Hull-form design and testing technology for wing-in-ground-effect craft (“冲翼艇”).

blocks.zh: 5.气翼艇船型的技术
blocks.en: 5. Hull-form technology for air-wing craft (“气翼艇”).

blocks.zh: 6.喷水推进动力设计技术与喷水推进快速性预报技术
blocks.en: 6. Waterjet propulsion power design technology and prediction technology for vessel speed performance under waterjet propulsion.

blocks.zh: 7.内河推轮、拖轮〔1.1≤（螺旋桨直径/吃水）≤1.4〕倒车舵、导管舵、襟翼舵推进操作系统技术
blocks.en: 7. Propulsion and maneuvering system technology using reversing rudders, duct rudders, and flap rudders for inland-waterway pushboats and tugboats with 1.1 ≤ (propeller diameter/draft) ≤ 1.4.

blocks.zh: 8.内河船舶〔1.1≤（螺旋桨直径/吃水）≤1.4〕艉型流场技术
blocks.en: 8. Stern-form flow-field technology for inland-waterway vessels with 1.1 ≤ (propeller diameter/draft) ≤ 1.4.

blocks.zh:
9.船舶螺旋桨整流毂帽技术
（1）消除毂帽空泡技术
（2）毂形、小叶翼型剖面设计方法
blocks.en:
9. Flow-straightening hub-cap technology for ship propellers:
(1) Technology for eliminating hub-cap cavitation.
(2) Design methods for hub shape and small-fin airfoil sections.

blocks.zh: 10.船舶油水分离技术
blocks.en: 10. Marine oil-water separation technology.

summary.zh: 涉及特定船型、推进与操纵、船舶油水分离及水下机器人浮体和密封材料技术；须按各控制点核对。
summary.en: Covers specified hull forms, propulsion and maneuvering, marine oil-water separation, and underwater-robot buoyancy and sealing materials; review the individual control points.

title.en: Shipbuilding processes

industry.zh: 铁路、船舶、航空航天和其他运输设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of railway, ship, aerospace and other transportation equipment

blocks.zh:
1.直径>3m的铜合金螺旋桨铸造反变形技术
（1）叶片压力面螺距和叶片倾角的变形

blocks.en:

blocks.zh: 2.柴油机双层隔振技术
blocks.en: 2. Two-stage vibration-isolation technology for diesel engines.

summary.zh: 涉及直径大于3米铜合金螺旋桨铸造反变形及柴油机双层隔振技术。
summary.en: Covers casting counter-deformation for copper-alloy propellers over 3 m in diameter and two-stage vibration isolation for diesel engines.

industry.en: Manufacture of railway, ship, aerospace and other transportation equipment

blocks.zh:
1.含稀土的铝锂合金的制备技术
（1）所含稀土元素的种类与含量及加入稀土元素的方法
blocks.en:
1. Preparation technology for aluminum-lithium alloys containing rare-earth elements:
(1) The types and contents of rare-earth elements and the methods of adding them.

blocks.zh:
2.含钨（W）同时含铪（Hf）量1.5%～2.5%的定向凝固高温合金生产技术
（1）合金成分的选择与控制
（2）冶炼工艺和定向结晶工艺
（3）热处理工艺流程及规范
blocks.en:
2. Production technology for directionally solidified superalloys containing tungsten (W) and also 1.5%–2.5% hafnium (Hf):
(1) Selection and control of alloy composition.
(2) Smelting and directional-crystallization processes.
(3) Heat-treatment process sequences and specifications.

blocks.zh:
3.多极各向异性铸造磁钢的生产技术
（1）制造工艺
（2）测磁技术
blocks.en:
3. Production technology for multipole anisotropic cast permanent magnets:
(1) Manufacturing processes.
(2) Magnetic measurement technology.

blocks.zh:
4.单晶涡轮叶片连接用中间层合金的制备技术
（1）Ni-Co-Cr-W-Hf（镍-钴-铬-钨-铪）系合金的成分
（2）中间层合金的制备工艺
blocks.en:
4. Preparation technology for interlayer alloys used to join single-crystal turbine blades:
(1) Composition of Ni-Co-Cr-W-Hf (nickel-cobalt-chromium-tungsten-hafnium) alloys.
(2) Interlayer-alloy preparation processes.

summary.zh: 涉及含稀土铝锂合金、特定含钨铪高温合金、铸造磁钢及单晶叶片连接用合金。
summary.en: Covers rare-earth-containing aluminum-lithium alloys, specified tungsten-hafnium superalloys, cast permanent magnets, and alloys for joining single-crystal blades.

title.zh: 电线、电缆制造技术
title.en: Wire and cable manufacturing technology

industry.zh: 电气机械和器材制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of electrical machinery and equipment

blocks.zh:
1.同时满足下列条件的不燃烧电缆绝缘材料的配方及制备工艺
（1）使用温度＞250℃
（2）800℃明火≥1.5h不燃烧
（3）耐电压≥2,500V
blocks.en:
1. Formulations and preparation processes for noncombustible cable insulation materials meeting all of the following conditions:
(1) Operating temperature > 250°C.
(2) No combustion during exposure to an 800°C open flame for ≥ 1.5 h.
(3) Withstand voltage ≥ 2,500 V.

blocks.zh: 2.核电站用对称射频电缆的制造工艺
blocks.en: 2. Manufacturing processes for balanced radio-frequency cables for nuclear power plants.

blocks.zh: 3.导电用稀土铝导线的配方和制造工艺
blocks.en: 3. Formulations and manufacturing processes for rare-earth aluminum conductors used for electrical conduction.

blocks.zh: 4.高速挤出聚氯乙烯电缆料的配方
blocks.en: 4. Formulations for high-speed-extrusion PVC cable compounds.

blocks.zh: 5.核电站用电力、控制和仪表电缆的制造工艺
blocks.en: 5. Manufacturing processes for power, control and instrumentation cables for nuclear power plants.

blocks.zh: 6.高温（120℃）铝护套潜油泵电缆的制造技术
blocks.en: 6. Manufacturing technology for high-temperature (120°C), aluminum-sheathed cables for submersible oil pumps.

summary.zh: 涵盖特定耐火绝缘配方、核电站电缆、稀土铝导线及其他列明电缆技术；并非所有电线电缆。
summary.en: Covers specified fire-resistant insulation formulations, nuclear-plant cables, rare-earth aluminum conductors and other listed cable technologies; it does not describe all wires and cables.

title.zh: 电子器件制造技术
title.en: Electronic-device manufacturing technology

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of computers, communications equipment and other electronic equipment

blocks.zh:
1.宽带小型化隔离器制造技术
（1）超倍频程宽带（相对带宽≥70%）小型化隔离器设计及制造工艺
（2）极窄铁磁共振线宽△H＜2奥斯特的铁氧体材料配方及制备工艺
（3）超宽带（相对带宽≥70％）匹配技术及宽温（-55℃～+125℃）补偿技术
blocks.en:
1. Manufacturing technology for broadband miniaturized isolators
(1) Design and manufacturing processes for miniaturized isolators with bandwidth exceeding one octave (relative bandwidth ≥ 70%).
(2) Formulations and preparation processes for ferrite materials with an extremely narrow ferromagnetic-resonance linewidth ΔH < 2 oersteds.
(3) Ultra-wideband matching technology (relative bandwidth ≥ 70%) and wide-temperature compensation technology (-55°C to +125°C).

blocks.zh: 2.宽带（2～8GHz）悬置带线频分器设计技术及制造工艺
blocks.en: 2. Design technology and manufacturing processes for broadband (2–8 GHz) suspended-stripline frequency diplexers.

blocks.zh:
3.压电陀螺敏感器件制造技术
（1）支撑系统的设计与制造工艺
（2）压电换能器的贴接工艺
（3）金属振梁的结构设计、工艺及热处理技术
（4）校零系统结构设计及组装技术
（5）校零信号处理技术
blocks.en:
3. Manufacturing technology for piezoelectric gyroscope sensing elements
(1) Design and manufacturing processes for support systems.
(2) Bonding processes for piezoelectric transducers.
(3) Structural design, processing and heat-treatment technology for metal vibrating beams.
(4) Structural design and assembly technology for zero-adjustment systems.
(5) Signal-processing technology for zero adjustment.

blocks.zh:
4.声表面波器件设计技术
（1）声表面波滤波器（频率＞2GHz，带外抑制＞70dB，插入衰耗＜1.5dB）
（2）声表面波抽头延迟线（码位＞1023位，工作频率＞600MHz）
（3）声表面波卷积器（码位＞1023位，工作频率＞600MHz）
（4）声表面波固定延迟线（频率＞2GHz，延迟时间＞300μs）
（5）声表面波色散延迟线（频率＞500MHz，时带积＞10000，旁瓣抑制＞32dB）
（6）声表面波脉压线（旁瓣抑制＞32dB，二阶杂波信号模拟计算技术，副瓣抑制加权补偿方法，相位误差补偿技术）
blocks.en:
4. Design technology for surface acoustic wave devices
(1) Surface acoustic wave filters (frequency > 2 GHz, out-of-band rejection > 70 dB and insertion loss < 1.5 dB).
(2) Surface acoustic wave tapped delay lines (code length > 1,023 bits and operating frequency > 600 MHz).
(3) Surface acoustic wave convolvers (code length > 1,023 bits and operating frequency > 600 MHz).
(4) Surface acoustic wave fixed delay lines (frequency > 2 GHz and delay time > 300 μs).
(5) Surface acoustic wave dispersive delay lines (frequency > 500 MHz, time-bandwidth product > 10,000 and sidelobe suppression > 32 dB).
(6) Surface acoustic wave pulse-compression lines (sidelobe suppression > 32 dB; simulation and calculation technology for second-order clutter signals; weighted-compensation methods for sidelobe suppression; and phase-error compensation technology).

blocks.zh:
5.声表面波器件制造技术
（1）组合技术
（2）匹配技术
（3）大面积（220mm×20mm）光刻技术
blocks.en:
5. Manufacturing technology for surface acoustic wave devices
(1) Combination technology.
(2) Matching technology.
(3) Large-area (220 mm × 20 mm) photolithography technology.

blocks.zh: 6.驻波加速管耐回轰电子枪设计及制造技术
blocks.en: 6. Design and manufacturing technology for electron guns resistant to back-bombardment in standing-wave accelerator tubes.

blocks.zh: 7.多注速调管设计及聚焦技术
blocks.en: 7. Design and focusing technology for multibeam klystrons.

blocks.zh: 8.离子束处理改善栅网电子发射技术
blocks.en: 8. Technology for improving grid electron emission through ion-beam treatment.

summary.zh: 涉及特定宽带隔离器、悬置带线器件、压电陀螺、声表面波器件及电子枪等技术，须分别核对各控制点。
summary.en: Covers specified broadband isolators, suspended-stripline devices, piezoelectric gyroscopes, surface acoustic wave devices and electron guns. Review each relevant control point.

blocks.zh:
中心锥形槽状光敏门极的大功率光控双向晶闸管
（1）Cr-Ni-Ag（铬-镍-银）金属阻挡层烧结技术

title.zh: 光纤制造及光纤通信技术

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of computers, communications equipment, and other electronic equipment

blocks.zh:
1.二氧化碳（CO₂）激光传输光纤制造技术
（1）10.6μm处光损耗<1dB/m的玻璃光纤的成份及制备技术
（2）10.6μm处光损耗<0.5dB/m的晶体光纤制备技术
（3）10.6μm处光损耗<1dB/m的空芯光纤制备技术
blocks.en:
1. Manufacturing technology for optical fibers transmitting carbon dioxide (CO₂) laser radiation:
(1) Composition and preparation technology for glass optical fibers with optical loss < 1 dB/m at 10.6 μm.
(2) Preparation technology for crystalline optical fibers with optical loss < 0.5 dB/m at 10.6 μm.
(3) Preparation technology for hollow-core optical fibers with optical loss < 1 dB/m at 10.6 μm.

blocks.zh: 2.双坩埚的制造及20孔坩埚拉制光学玻璃纤维技术
blocks.en: 2. Double-crucible manufacturing technology and technology for drawing optical glass fibers using a 20-hole crucible.

blocks.zh: 3.光纤拉丝被覆流水线技术的工艺参数
blocks.en: 3. Process parameters for optical fiber drawing and coating production lines.

blocks.zh: 4.可编程数字锁相频率合成技术；DDS+PLL跳频信号源
blocks.en: 4. Programmable digital phase-locked frequency synthesis technology; DDS + PLL frequency-hopping signal sources.

summary.zh: 涉及特定二氧化碳激光传输光纤、坩埚拉丝、被覆工艺参数及数字锁相频率合成技术。
summary.en: Covers specified fibers for CO₂ laser transmission, crucible drawing, coating-line process parameters, and digital phase-locked frequency synthesis.

keywords: 光纤制造及光纤通信技术
Optical fiber manufacturing and optical fiber communications technology

title.zh: 无线通信技术
title.en: Wireless communications technology

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of computers, communications equipment and other electronic equipment

blocks.zh:
1.天线阵技术
（1）超过一个倍频程的宽带（中心频率≥100%）天线阵
（2）宽带（在C波段>800MHz）馈源精密加工工艺
blocks.en:
1. Antenna-array technology
(1) Broadband antenna arrays exceeding one octave (the source states “中心频率≥100%,” literally “center frequency ≥ 100%”).
(2) Precision machining processes for broadband feeds (> 800 MHz in the C band).

blocks.zh: 2.微波直接调制分频锁相固态源加工工艺技术
blocks.en: 2. Processing technology for microwave direct-modulation, frequency-division, phase-locked solid-state sources.

blocks.zh: 3.带宽>100MHz、动态范围>90dB的集成声光外差接收技术
blocks.en: 3. Integrated acousto-optic heterodyne reception technology with bandwidth > 100 MHz and dynamic range > 90 dB.

blocks.zh: 4.C/No低于46dB.Hz的CDMA突发信号快速捕获技术
blocks.en: 4. Fast acquisition technology for CDMA burst signals with C/No below 46 dB·Hz.

summary.zh: 涉及指定宽带天线阵、微波固态源、声光外差接收及低载噪比CDMA突发信号捕获技术。
summary.en: Covers specified broadband antenna arrays, microwave solid-state sources, acousto-optic heterodyne reception and CDMA burst-signal acquisition at low carrier-to-noise-density ratios.

title.zh: 计量基、标准制造及量值传递技术
title.en: Manufacture of primary and other measurement standards, and dissemination of measurement values

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of computers, communications equipment and other electronic equipment

blocks.zh:
1.准确度≤2×10⁻⁴，年稳定性≤10⁻⁴的镯环形电感器的制造技术
（1）电感线圈的绕制、屏蔽技术
（2）镯环形电感线圈温度补偿技术
（3）防潮防震技术
blocks.en:
1. Manufacturing technology for toroidal inductors with accuracy ≤ 2 × 10⁻⁴ and annual stability ≤ 10⁻⁴
(1) Winding and shielding technology for inductance coils.
(2) Temperature-compensation technology for toroidal inductance coils.
(3) Moisture-proofing and vibration-protection technology.

blocks.zh: 2.射频电压标准射频座结构设计及薄膜辐条状热变电阻制造技术
blocks.en: 2. Structural design of radio-frequency mounts for radio-frequency voltage standards, and manufacturing technology for thin-film spoke-shaped thermoresistive elements.

blocks.zh: 3.标准时间的卫星传递技术
blocks.en: 3. Satellite transfer technology for standard time.

blocks.zh: 4.氦－氖稳频（波长相对变化量△λ/λ＝10⁻¹⁰～10⁻¹¹）光器碘室、激光管、谐振腔镜制造工艺及参数
blocks.en: 4. Manufacturing processes and parameters for iodine cells, laser tubes and resonator mirrors of frequency-stabilized helium–neon optical devices (relative wavelength variation Δλ/λ = 10⁻¹⁰ to 10⁻¹¹; the source wording is “光器碘室”).

blocks.zh:
5.电替代辐射计接收腔制造技术
（1）吸收率≥0.998的电替代辐射计中金属腔的制造工艺
（2）金属腔的电加热器制造技术
blocks.en:
5. Manufacturing technology for receiver cavities of electrical-substitution radiometers
(1) Manufacturing processes for metal cavities in electrical-substitution radiometers with absorptance ≥ 0.998.
(2) Manufacturing technology for electrical heaters in metal cavities.

summary.zh: 涉及特定精度电感标准、射频电压标准、卫星时间传递、氦氖稳频及电替代辐射计技术。
summary.en: Covers specified inductance and radio-frequency voltage standards, satellite time transfer, stabilized helium–neon lasers and electrical-substitution radiometers.

keywords: 计量基、标准制造及量值传递技术

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业

blocks.en: 1. Key technologies for miniature mission payloads, autonomous navigation, adaptive control, sensing and avoidance, highly reliable communications, airspace management and related functions in different classes of fixed-wing and rotary-wing UAVs.

blocks.en: 3. Counter-UAV technologies such as electromagnetic-interference guns.

industry.zh: 计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of computers, communications and other electronic equipment

blocks.zh: 符合以下任一条件的激光探测及测距系统技术：脉冲峰值功率（peak power）＞30kW、脉冲宽度（pulse width）＜1ns、探测距离（detection range）＞2km、角准度（angular accuracy）＜40μrad、角分辨率（angular resolution）＜20μrad、测距精度（ranging accuracy）＜2mm

summary.en: Sets six alternative conditions for laser detection and ranging system technology. Meeting any one condition calls for checking the relevant technology scope; meeting all six is not required.

title.zh: 信息处理技术
title.en: Information-processing technology

industry.zh: 软件和信息技术服务业

blocks.zh: 1.智能汉字语音开发工具技术
blocks.en: 1. Technology for intelligent Chinese-character speech development tools.

blocks.zh: 2.字符式汉字显示控制器的设计、制造工艺
blocks.en: 2. Design and manufacturing processes for character-based Chinese-character display controllers.

blocks.zh: 3.计算机中文系统的核心关键技术
blocks.en: 3. Core key technologies for Chinese-language computer systems.

blocks.zh: 4.工程图纸计算机辅助设计（CAD）及档案管理系统光栅/矢量混合信息处理方法
blocks.en: 4. Raster/vector hybrid information-processing methods for engineering-drawing CAD and archive-management systems.

blocks.zh: 5.中文平台技术（中文处理核心技术）
blocks.en: 5. Chinese-language platform technology, including core Chinese-language processing technology.

blocks.zh: 6.中译外翻译技术（机器翻译系统得分＞4.5分，满分为5分）
blocks.en: 6. Chinese-to-foreign-language translation technology with a machine-translation system score > 4.5 on a 5-point scale.

blocks.zh: 7.少数民族语言处理技术
blocks.en: 7. Processing technology for ethnic-minority languages.

blocks.zh: 8.专门用于汉语及少数民族语言的语音识别技术
blocks.en: 8. Speech-recognition technology specifically for Chinese and ethnic-minority languages.

blocks.zh: 9.汉字压缩、还原技术
blocks.en: 9. Chinese-character compression and restoration technology.

blocks.zh: 10.印刷体汉字识别技术、程序结构、主要算法和源程序
blocks.en: 10. Printed Chinese-character recognition technology, program structures, principal algorithms and source programs.

blocks.zh: 11.Videotex（可视图文）系统的汉字处理技术及网间控制技术
blocks.en: 11. Chinese-character processing and inter-network control technology for Videotex systems.

blocks.zh: 12.具有交互和自学习功能的脱机手写汉字识别系统及方法
blocks.en: 12. Offline handwritten Chinese-character recognition systems and methods with interactive and self-learning functions.

blocks.zh: 13.用于计算机汉字输入识别方法中的手写体样张、印刷体样张以及汉语语料库
blocks.en: 13. Handwritten and printed samples and Chinese-language corpora used in computerised Chinese-character input-recognition methods.

blocks.zh: 14.汉字识别的特征抽取方法和实现文本切分技术的源程序
blocks.en: 14. Feature-extraction methods for Chinese-character recognition and source programs implementing text segmentation.

blocks.zh: 15.专门用于汉语及少数民族语言的语音合成技术
blocks.en: 15. Speech-synthesis technology specifically for Chinese and ethnic-minority languages.

blocks.zh: 16.专门用于汉语及少数民族语言的人工智能交互界面技术
blocks.en: 16. Artificial-intelligence interface technology specifically for Chinese and ethnic-minority languages.

blocks.zh: 17.专门用于汉语及少数民族语言的智能阅卷技术
blocks.en: 17. Intelligent examination-grading technology specifically for Chinese and ethnic-minority languages.

blocks.zh: 18.基于数据分析的个性化信息推送服务技术（基于海量数据持续训练优化的用户个性化偏好学习技术、用户个性化偏好实时感知技术、信息内容特征建模技术、用户偏好与信息内容匹配分析技术、用于支撑推荐算法的大规模分布式实时计算技术等）
blocks.en: 18. Personalized information-delivery service technology based on data analysis, including learning individual user preferences through continuous training and optimization on large volumes of data; real-time sensing of user preferences; modeling information-content features; analyzing matches between user preferences and information content; and large-scale distributed real-time computing supporting recommendation algorithms.

summary.zh: 涵盖18项信息处理技术，包括特定汉语及少数民族语言处理、识别、合成、交互和个性化信息推送。AI或算法关键词只用于查找，不能据此认定所有人工智能技术受限。
summary.en: Covers 18 information-processing control points, including specified Chinese and ethnic-minority language processing, recognition, synthesis, interfaces and personalized information delivery. AI and algorithm keywords are retrieval aids; they do not mean that all AI technology is restricted.

title.zh: 计量测试技术
title.en: Metrological measurement and testing technology

blocks.zh:
1.六氟化硫微量含水量测量技术
（1）检测限十万分之三（体积分数）的传感器制造技术
blocks.en:
1. Measurement technology for trace moisture in sulfur hexafluoride:
(1) Sensor manufacturing technology with a detection limit of three parts per hundred thousand (volume fraction).

blocks.zh:
2.氯化钠温度定点技术
（1）相平衡态时氯化钠密度值

（3）定点黑体防泄漏技术
blocks.en:
2. Sodium chloride temperature fixed-point technology:
(1) Sodium chloride density values at phase equilibrium.
(2) Technology for improving heat transfer and preventing corrosion in sealed cavities.
(3) Leakage-prevention technology for fixed-point blackbodies.

summary.zh: 涉及六氟化硫微量水分传感器及氯化钠温度定点技术。
summary.en: Covers trace-moisture sensors for sulfur hexafluoride and sodium chloride temperature fixed-point technology.

nextStep.zh: 先确认本次交易是否涉及向境外转移该条目的技术，再核对控制要点及是否涉及军民两用技术，并向所在地省级商务主管部门核实适用的办理路径。如适用技术进出口管理制度下的限制技术许可程序，应核实实质性谈判或作出具有法律效力的承诺前的许可意向书要求。不得仅因目录与两用物项规则同时命中，就假定须重复办理两套许可。
nextStep.en: First establish whether the transaction transfers technology covered by this entry outside China, then check the control points and whether the technology is dual-use. Consult the competent provincial commerce authority about the applicable procedure. Where the restricted-technology licensing procedure under the technology import/export regime applies, check the letter-of-intent requirement before substantive negotiations or legally binding commitments. A match under both this catalog and dual-use rules does not by itself establish that two separate licensing procedures must be duplicated.

criteriaHints.zh: 按相关控制点逐项阅读技术内容、数值条件、并列关系及例外。目录援引其他名录、标准或资源范围时，还须核实被援引文件；条目名称、关键词或局部条件不能替代完整范围核对。
criteriaHints.en: Read each relevant control point together with its technical content, numerical criteria, logical relationships and exceptions. Where an entry refers to another list, standard or resource scope, verify that referenced document as well. A title, keyword or partial criterion does not replace a complete scope review.

title.zh: 电池正极材料制备技术
title.en: Preparation technology for battery cathode materials

summary.zh: 涉及磷酸铁锂、磷酸锰铁锂及磷酸盐正极原材料的制备技术。技术范围与材料参数需要一起核对，不能仅凭“电池”或材料名称确定适用。
summary.en: Covers preparation technology for lithium iron phosphate, lithium manganese iron phosphate and phosphate cathode raw materials. Check both the technology transferred and the material criteria; a battery or material name alone does not establish applicability.

keywords: 电池正极材料制备技术
Preparation technology for battery cathode materials

industry.zh: 化学原料和化学制品制造业
industry.en: Manufacture of chemicals and chemical products

blocks.zh:
1.同时满足以下条件的电池用磷酸铁锂制备技术
（1）化学通式LixFeyMzPO4，其中x，y，z≥0，M为除Li、Fe之外的其他一个或多个元素
（2）该材料在220MPa下粉体压实密度≥2.58g/cc，0.1C放电克容量≥160mAh/g，首次库伦效率≥97%
blocks.en:
1. Preparation technology for battery-use lithium iron phosphate meeting all of the following conditions:
(1) General chemical formula LixFeyMzPO4, where x, y and z ≥ 0, and M is one or more elements other than Li and Fe.
(2) Powder compaction density at 220 MPa ≥ 2.58 g/cc; discharge specific capacity at 0.1C ≥ 160 mAh/g; and first-cycle Coulombic efficiency ≥ 97%.

blocks.zh:
2.同时满足以下条件的电池用磷酸锰铁锂制备技术
（1）化学通式LixFeyMnzMaPO4，其中x，y，z，a≥0，M为除Li、Fe、Mn之外的一个或多个元素
（2）该材料在220MPa下粉体压实密度≥2.38g/cc，0.1C首次库伦效率≥95%，0.1C放电克容量≥155mAh/g，0.1C平均电压≥3.85V
blocks.en:
2. Preparation technology for battery-use lithium manganese iron phosphate meeting all of the following conditions:
(1) General chemical formula LixFeyMnzMaPO4, where x, y, z and a ≥ 0, and M is one or more elements other than Li, Fe and Mn.
(2) Powder compaction density at 220 MPa ≥ 2.38 g/cc; first-cycle Coulombic efficiency at 0.1C ≥ 95%; discharge specific capacity at 0.1C ≥ 155 mAh/g; and average voltage at 0.1C ≥ 3.85 V.

blocks.zh:
3.磷酸盐正极原材料制备技术
（1）磷酸铁、磷酸铁锰、电池用草酸亚铁、电池用磷酸二（一）氢锂、电池用磷酸锂制备工艺，其中磷酸铁同时满足以下条件：振实密度＞1.2g/cc，磁性异物＜10ppb
blocks.en:
3. Preparation technology for phosphate cathode raw materials:
(1) Preparation processes for iron phosphate, iron manganese phosphate, battery-use ferrous oxalate, battery-use lithium hydrogen / dihydrogen phosphate (the source wording is “磷酸二（一）氢锂”), and battery-use lithium phosphate. For iron phosphate specifically, both of the following conditions apply: tapped density > 1.2 g/cc and magnetic foreign matter < 10 ppb.

Consult the competent provincial commerce authority about the applicable procedure. Where the restricted-technology licensing procedure under the technology import/export regime applies, check the letter-of-intent requirement before substantive negotiations or legally binding commitments. criteriaHints.zh: 第1、2项各自的配方与数值条件均须同时满足。第3项的两个数值条件只修饰磷酸铁。粉体压实密度与振实密度不同；缺少测试条件或指标时应保留“待核对”，不能以成品电池参数替代。
criteriaHints.en: For points 1 and 2, the formula and all numerical conditions within the selected point must be met together. The two numerical conditions in point 3 apply specifically to iron phosphate. Powder compaction density and tapped density are different measurements. Missing values or test conditions remain unresolved; finished-cell specifications are not substitutes.

title.zh: 2026年第48号公告：出口前登记与拟议目录调整
title.en: Announcement No. 48 of 2026: pre-export registration and proposed catalog changes

registrationEffectiveUntil.en: Until implementation of the formal catalog amendment

summary.zh: 公告就人工智能、生物医药、光伏领域40项技术征求意见；拟议禁止/限制分类不能当作已经生效的新增目录条目。公告同时规定，相关附件范围内的技术自公告发布日起至正式调整实施前，应在出口前办理登记，已启动但未完成的出口也纳入。
summary.en: The announcement seeks comments on 40 technologies in artificial intelligence, biomedicine and photovoltaics. Proposed prohibited/restricted classifications are not final new catalog entries. Separately, it requires pre-export registration for technology within the annex scope from publication until the formal amendment takes effect, including exports already initiated but not completed.

coverage.zh: 公告附件的具体登记范围尚未编码为自动判定规则；不能凭AI、生物医药或光伏等宽泛词语确认或排除登记义务。请核对公告附件的具体技术范围。
coverage.en: The annex’s specific registration scope has not been encoded as automated decision rules. Broad terms such as AI, biomedicine or photovoltaics cannot establish or rule out a registration obligation. Verify the specific technology scope in the official annex.
